paper.title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
paper.data: 44,000+ hours of egocentric human video spanning daily environments, objects, and dexterous interactions, followed by small target-robot post-training sets.
paper.method: A video foundation world model pretrained with continuous latent proxy actions on unlabeled human video, robot-action post-training, and few-step autoregressive distillation for real-time rollout.
paper.task: Generate action-conditioned robot futures for teleoperation, policy evaluation, and model-based planning across embodiments.
paper.novelty: Transfers interaction knowledge from unprecedented-scale unlabeled human video into a controllable robot world model and distills it to sustained real-time generation.
paper.project_relevance: A strong reference for latent action fields, action-conditioned rollout, real-time simulation, cross-embodiment adaptation, and neural policy-evaluation interfaces.

paper.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
paper.data: Short real-world videos converted into digital twins plus object, scene, and task digital cousins across seven manipulation tasks and five policy architectures.
paper.method: A modular extraction-generation-augmentation pipeline segments a video, reconstructs objects and background, estimates physics and articulation, compiles an OmniGibson scene, and generates affordance-preserving cousins.
paper.task: Automatically build editable simulation-ready scenes for robot-policy training and evaluation from real video.
paper.novelty: Connects automated real-to-sim reconstruction with systematic digital-cousin generation and validates both policy ranking and zero-shot real transfer.
paper.project_relevance: Direct compiler reference for SceneAsset, Articulation, PhysicalParameter, DigitalTwin, DigitalCousin, TaskVariant, and sim-real validation fields.

paper.title: MolmoB0T: Large-Scale Simulation Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation
paper.data: 1.7M expert manipulation trajectories over 11K+ objects, 94K+ procedurally generated environments, eight tasks, and Franka FR3 plus RB-Y1 embodiments.
paper.method: A suite of behavior-cloned policies trained only on aggressively randomized procedural simulation data, with VLM-based, lightweight-transformer, and pi0-compatible architectures.
paper.task: Zero-shot sim-to-real pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and door opening on unseen objects and environments.
paper.novelty: Demonstrates a fully open sim-only manipulation stack that transfers zero-shot to two real robot platforms without target-domain fine-tuning.
paper.project_relevance: Useful baseline for synthetic-only policy training, procedural diversity, domain randomization, embodiment transfer, and open sim-to-real evaluation.

paper.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
paper.data: A curated SFT mixture spanning localization, navigation, spatial intelligence, grounding, embodied reasoning, general VLM data, and real-robot action planning.
paper.method: Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning plus a multimodal memory harness that interleaves observations, textual progress state, reasoning, and next-subtask actions for hierarchical control.
paper.task: Unify spatial grounding, navigation, embodied QA, memory, and long-horizon robot planning in a single model.
paper.novelty: Shows that one embodied reasoning checkpoint can match specialist systems while retaining explicit episodic memory and tool-calling for robot planning.
paper.project_relevance: Provides a concrete memory-and-planning interface for Observation, Progress, Reasoning, Action, EpisodicMemory, PixelGoal, and ToolCall fields.

paper.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
paper.data: Joint pretraining over robot manipulation trajectories, egocentric human demonstrations, simulation, vision-language navigation, trajectory supervision, and auxiliary vision-language data.
paper.method: A Qwen vision-language backbone with a DiT continuous-action decoder and embodiment-aware textual conditioning that unifies manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction.
paper.task: Generate continuous actions and trajectories across tasks, environments, and heterogeneous robot embodiments.
paper.novelty: Treats manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction as one transferable action-generation problem instead of separate specialist policies.
paper.project_relevance: Strong multi-task VLA baseline for EmbodimentDescription, ControlConvention, ContinuousAction, NavigationWaypoint, and trajectory-transfer schemas.

paper.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
paper.data: LIBERO simulation and six real DROID manipulation tasks using pi0.5 flow-matching VLA policies, coarse human/VLM guidance, and small task-specific steering sets.
paper.method: Reverse-integrates a flow policy from a coarse reference action into latent noise, then denoises toward a nearby in-distribution behavior; discovered noises support zero-shot steering, behavioral cloning, or RL bootstrapping.
paper.task: Elicit useful modes from a frozen generalist flow policy for hard new robot tasks.
paper.novelty: Uses the invertible correspondence of flow matching to translate coarse semantic actions into precise policy-native actions and a compact learnable noise-space controller.
paper.project_relevance: Reusable inference-time adaptation reference for ReferenceAction, LatentNoise, FlowReverse, SteeringPolicy, SemanticReasoner, and sparse-reward bootstrapping.

paper.title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
paper.data: Nine tasks across MiniGrid, RoboMimic, and ManiSkill, combining action-labeled transitions with broader action-free video-derived subgoals.
paper.method: Factorizes verification into state plausibility and action reachability, using a video-trained subgoal generator, sparse inverse dynamics, and forward-cycle consistency to target model failures.
paper.task: Let a world model discover under-covered failures, collect useful transitions, and improve downstream imagination-based policy learning.
paper.novelty: Turns forward-inverse asymmetry into a self-verification and exploration mechanism instead of estimating forward-model uncertainty directly.
paper.project_relevance: Direct design reference for Plausibility, Reachability, InverseAction, CycleConsistency, ActionFollowingScore, and model-error-directed collection.

paper.title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
paper.data: Open synchronized medical-robot video and kinematics from 49+ institutions and multiple platforms across surgery, ultrasound, and endoscopy.
paper.method: A cross-institution, multi-embodiment data standard plus GR00T-H VLA and Cosmos-H action-conditioned surgical world-model baselines.
paper.task: Train and evaluate medical robot foundation models, action prediction, and multi-embodiment surgical simulation.
paper.novelty: Provides the largest reported open synchronized medical-robot corpus and demonstrates both a VLA and one-checkpoint multi-platform world model on it.
paper.project_relevance: Extends embodied data infrastructure with synchronized video-kinematics, clinical embodiment metadata, multi-platform action schemas, and long-horizon procedure evaluation.
